sloka: अन्योन्यम् संपरिष्वज्य जग्मुर् योजनम् अंतरम् ।ते नष्ट संज्ञाः तृषिताः संभ्रांताः सलिल अर्थिनः ॥४-५०-२२॥
transliteration: anyonyam saṁpariṣvajya jagmur yojanam aṁtaram ।te naṣṭa saṁjñāḥ tṛṣitāḥ saṁbhrāṁtāḥ salila arthinaḥ ॥4-50-22॥

translations.english: Having nearly lost their senses (without water to drink), the thirsty and bewildered monkeys were desperate for water.They wandered in the cave without feeling lazy for some time.
